text: I think you'll really enjoy this Mexican-Style Rice recipe, which not only fits within your 60-minute time budget but also aligns with your preference for rice and chicken. Although it doesn't contain chicken, the dish is quite flavorful and satisfying on its own. Additionally, it's low in saturated fat, which aligns with your health goal. The recipe is also relatively simple and quick to prepare, making it a great option for a weeknight dinner.
